description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

trading_window.note: Signals generated only within this GMT window. Routine will abort outside it.

confluence.note: Raise min_categories_for_buy to 5 for stricter filtering in choppy markets

risk.note: vix_max triggers full kill-switch. vix_caution raises confluence bar to 5/6.

earnings.note: No signals within this window around any earnings date

macro_kill_switches.note: Set to false only if you want signals on those days (not recommended)
